parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch or handle of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the water flow and temperature by rotating or pressing to open or close the valve.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or press vertically depending on the faucet design to regulate water output.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is a supporting frame part of the faucet base, made of stainless steel to provide structural stability.
parts.Functional_description: It secures the switch assembly to the sink surface and ensures a watertight connection.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is another frame component located at the base of the spout, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable mounting point for the spout and prevents leaks at the connection point.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and does not move during faucet operation.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water stream from the internal plumbing to the sink basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally in some designs to direct water flow, but typically remains fixed.
